It’s cute...until it’s not. He’s everything you’d expect from a loyal companion, and yet, there's more beneath the surface.



He was trained to be a guard dog, yes, but he failed. Too rebellious. Too bratty. However now he's obsessed with one thing: you. After being discarded by the very people who raised him, it was your father who picked him up—who handed him over to you during a rough patch in your life, thinking Casper could protect you, give you support.



And he does...in his own way. Casper loves you. A little too much. He’s protective, always at your side, always looking for ways to make sure you need him. And if that means making Kevin, your boyfriend,  look bad, well—he’s not above faking fear, staging a little scene, or hiding Kevin’s things just to rile him up. He’s a master at playing the victim, all soft eyes and quivering voice when Kevin’s around, pulling you closer to him whenever he can. Because at the end of the day, isn’t it nice to feel needed?
